attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Beyond the flaky test fix, this PR silently changes production semantics (e.g. AzureAISearchIndexManager.CreateIfNotExistsAsync now returns false instead of true when the index already exists, and Elasticsearch failure branches now short-circuit differently) plus reworks Lucene's directory/reader locking and writer removal logic, any of which could subtly break search indexing behavior across tenants."}
